content.introduction: The sources indicate a volatile week for stocks driven by AI concerns and Middle East tensions, leading to "risk-off" behavior. The Nasdaq and S&P 500 are on track for modest weekly losses, with a "bounce attempt" in the first half of the week followed by a strong sell-off on Thursday. WTI crude is up over 10% this week due to additional attacks in the Middle East and reports of Iran-backed Houthis tightening an encirclement around Yemen's Taiz. The SPX breadth moved up to 54.60% from 50.20%, the CCMP fell to 36.59% from 39.14%, and the RUT dropped to 45.87% from 48.00%. There is a forecast of 2.98 25-basis-point cuts between now and December 2027, down from 3.22 last Friday.
